new-york-catskills-route-23a-and-kaaters.title: New York · Catskills Route 23A and Kaaterskill High Road
new-york-catskills-route-23a-and-kaaters.slogan: A 401 km loop out of Kingston
new-york-catskills-route-23a-and-kaaters.story: Cooler air, forest bends and a mountain-town lunch window. 401 km round from Kingston - plan on about 7 h 43 of riding. The stops in between: Kaaterskill high road and Phoenicia. Hunter mountain edge is the high point. It is a high-mountain day.

sections.advice: This Kaaterskill high road → Hunter mountain edge stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
sections.photoQuery: Kingston fuel gate Kaaterskill high road New York

sections.advice: Hunter mountain edge → Phoenicia food stop is the reward section in New York. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

duku-highway-dushanzi-nalati.slogan: Dushanzi to Nalati, over 3400 m · one way, about 341 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Dushanzi

waypoints.advice: Hashilegen Pass comes up 171 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Nalati, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Dushanzi → Hashilegen Pass climbs about 3400 m in 130 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Hashilegen Pass → Nalati drops about 3400 m over 50 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

duku-highway-dushanzi-nalati.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Duku Highway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Dushanzi → Hashilegen Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 246 km. 3400 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Hashilegen Pass → Nalati
scenicChapters.narrative: 3400 m come off over 95 km at around 6.7%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

duku-highway-dushanzi-nalati.story: 341 km from Dushanzi to the finish, about 4 h 44 of riding. The highest point is about 3,400 m. Hashilegen Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
